result.description: Coastline Panel & Paint Max Auto Smash Repairs     Core Duties and Responsibilities   Electronic Diagnostics & Troubleshooting: Perform complex electronic fault-finding and diagnostics on collision-damaged vehicles using specialized automotive scan tools and computers.  DTC Management: Read, interpret, and clear Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTCs), establishing clear pathways for resetting electronic control units (ECUs).  Pre & Post-Scan Assessments: Conduct exhaustive pre-scan assessments to map crash impact damage and post-scan vehicle assessments to certify mechanical safety before delivery.  System Calibration & Configuration: Execute precise calibration and configuration of advanced electronic vehicle systems, including Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) such as radar, cameras, proximity sensors, and airbag modules.  Technical Assessment & Repair Planning: Conduct physical and electronic assessments of vehicle damage, supporting management with repair planning, determining OEM repair procedures, and identifying safety-critical mechanical and electronic components.  Maintenance & Repair Execution: Perform mechanical assembly/disassembly, routine, and emergency maintenance on mechanical assemblies, steering geometry, suspension components, and hydraulic systems impacted by collision forces.  Procurement Support: Prepare highly accurate parts lists, component requirements, and specialized technical repair specifications.  Quality Control & Compliance: Perform strict quality control inspections post-repair, verifying exact component alignment, fitment, and electronic functionality.  Workshop Technical Support: Provide active technical guidance to panel beating and body-repair staff during vehicle strip and refit operations.  Documentation: Fully document diagnostic data, calibration results, and repair procedures to maintain compliance with safety and insurance frameworks.   Skills, Qualifications & Experience Required   Qualifications: A relevant formal qualification  Experience: A minimum of 2 to 3 years of hands-on experience working with complex  electromechanical assemblies, technical diagnostics, and system testing/calibration. Prior experience diagnosing faults using technical scanners and software is essential.    Skills:  Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to trouble shoot, investigate and rectify Exceptional ability to read and interpret complex technical drawings, mechanical designs, and electronic circuit paths. Strong diagnostic capabilities and a methodical approach to system calibration are required. High-level attention to detail for safety-critical component alignment  About Company     Coastline Panel & Paint Max Auto Smash Repairs (CPMA) is a busy, clean, modern panel shop located in Tweed Heads. As vehicles evolve into highly complex electromechanical systems, our workshop relies heavily on advanced electronic diagnostic and recalibration procedures to return collision-damaged vehicles to original manufacturer safety standards.     We are seeking a skilled Mechanical Technician to lead our diagnostic, mechanical teardown, and systems configuration division.
